---
title: "Methodology"
subtitle: "How the numbers are produced, and how to read them"
toc: true
toc-location: right
---

```{r}
#| include: false
source("R/site.R")
```

```{r}
#| results: asis
cat(sprintf("This page describes **methodology version %s** (%s, %s).",
            METHODOLOGY$version, METHODOLOGY$status, METHODOLOGY$date),
    if (METHODOLOGY$status == "draft")
      "A draft version may still change, and so may the numbers measured under it."
    else "This version is frozen: neither it nor its results will change.",
    "Every number on this site was measured under it; other versions have their own site,",
    "reachable from the bar at the top of every page.\n")
```

```{r}
#| results: asis
# the version's own text, ../methodology/<version>.qmd (markdown and inline R only)
cat(knitr::knit_child(file.path(site_root(), "..", "methodology", paste0(METHODOLOGY$version, ".qmd")),
                      envir = globalenv(), quiet = TRUE))
```

```{r}
rs_table(data.frame(Category = CATEGORIES$category, Group = CATEGORIES$group,
                    `What it covers` = CATEGORIES$description, check.names = FALSE),
         pagination = FALSE, sortable = FALSE, columns = list(`What it covers` = colDef(minWidth = 360)))
```

## Methodology versions

```{r}
v <- METHODOLOGY_VERSIONS
rs_table(data.frame(Version = v$version, Status = v$status, Date = v$date, Summary = v$summary),
         pagination = FALSE, sortable = FALSE, columns = list(Summary = colDef(minWidth = 420)))
```
